items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bürgergeld decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland, Seelower Weg 12, 15344 Musterstrausberg einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter is dated (posted) Thu 19.11.2026. Jobcenter is a social-law body, so the Bekanntgabefiktion of § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (letter also states this itself), counting calendar days: 20.11 (day1, Fri), 21.11 (day2, Sat), 22.11 (day3, Sun), 23.11 (day4, Mon) → deemed delivered Mon 23.11.2026. For social-law bodies the delivery day does not move even onto a weekend/holiday. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 36a SGB I with §§ 187, 188 BGB) starts the day after delivery and ends one month later on the day with the same number: 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Brandenburg, so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X applies.

items.title: Submit landlord's 2025 utility/heating cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die Nebenkostenabrechnung Ihres Vermieters für 2025 bis 08.01.2027 ein.
items.computation: The letter gives an explicit calendar deadline of 08.01.2027. 08.01.2027 falls on a Friday, not a weekend or public holiday in Brandenburg, so the date stands as written without adjustment.
